jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Booking and Search domain)
jobs.description:
At Sunweb Group, we're building and evolving the core systems behind millions of holidays each year. As a Senior Software Engineer in Team Capri, you'll own our **Booking and Search domain**, which is at the heart of how customers find and book their holidays. You contribute directly to how our platform is designed, scaled and improved.

You'll work in a small, autonomous Agile team of four (two developers and two application engineers), where ownership, pragmatism and quality go hand in hand. This role goes beyond coding. You influence architecture, improve engineering practices and help the department grow.

**Location:** Rotterdam Sunweb Group office (Hybrid)

**Start date:** December 2026

**Availability**: Fulltime

**What you’ll do**

* Help define the team's technical vision and architectural direction.
* Own the Booking and Search domain and improve usability and performance for both customers and internal users.
* Work hands-on with the team on backlog items and complex technical challenges.
* Review designs and facilitate important technical decisions.
* Guide the maintenance and improvement of critical external applications and supporting tools, including updates pushed by our software vendor.
* Improve monitoring and alerting to enable fast response, and find structural fixes or mitigations.
* Work towards decoupling our systems from external applications by implementing an anti-corruption layer and creating a stable domain that shields our internal systems.
* Collaborate with business users, other engineering teams and software vendors on changes, issues and dependencies.
* Translate product needs into practical technical solutions and help break down complex work.
* Improve engineering quality through code reviews, documentation, pairing and knowledge sharing.
* Mentor engineers and help them grow their technical skills and ownership.
* Communicate technical risks, trade-offs and dependencies clearly.

**Our tech stack**

C#, .NET, Azure, SQL, React, GitHub, GitHub Copilot, Visual Studio / VS Code

We actively leverage AI-powered tools such as GitHub Copilot to improve productivity and code quality.

**What you bring**

* 5+ years of experience with C# and .NET
* Experience building cloud-native applications on Azure
* Strong knowledge of SQL and data modelling
* Solid understanding of system design and clean architecture
* Experience with CI/CD, automated testing and DevOps practices
* Experience with legacy systems and modernisation
* Ability to balance speed and quality pragmatically
* Ownership mindset and drive to improve systems and processes
* Strong stakeholder communication skills in English (Dutch is a big plus)
* Experience mentoring others and shaping the technical vision and direction of a team
* Experience with Kubernetes is a big plus

**What we offer**

* Yearly gross salary between 65K and 80K, excluding 8% holiday allowance).
* 25 holidays + 6 ATV days, based on fulltime employment. *Please note: ATV days do not apply to part-time contracts.*
* Enjoy up to 20% off when booking with our brands for you, your family, and your friends.
* As an international company we support a hybrid way of working. We provide you with office furniture and IT equipment.
* A personalized Reflect & Develop Plan to support your career growth.
* Benefit from coaching sessions designed to support your well-being.
* Receive work-from-home and travel allowances to ease your daily routine.

**About Sunweb Group**

Sunweb Group is one of Europe’s largest online travel platforms, with over 1.3 million customers annually. We operate in 8 international markets with 500+ colleagues across Europe. We combine scale with a fast-moving, ownership-driven culture where teams are trusted to build and improve continuously.

**Why this role is interesting**

* You have real influence on architecture and technical decisions.
* You'll help move a legacy architecture to a modern, domain-based structure.
* Your work directly affects millions of customers searching for and booking their holidays.
* A pragmatic engineering culture focused on impact, feedback and growth.
* An international product with real scale and complexity.
* The opportunity to own and shape the technical direction and ways of working of the team.

**Ready for departure?**

Do you want to become part of our team Capri as Senior Software Engineer? Click on “Apply”. Do you have any questions? Please feel free to reach out to our Talent Acquisition team via jobs@sunwebgroup.com. We are looking forward to hearing from you!

**Here’s what you can expect during our selection process:**

* **Initial conversation** (via video) with our Talent Acquisition Specialist
* **First interview** (via video/ live) with the Team Lead and Head of Tech
* **Second interview** (via video/ live) with the Team Lead and a team member

*Sunweb Group is an equal opportunity employer, which means we do not discriminate in any way. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive and safe environment for all employees.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - SDK and Visualization Engines
jobs.description:
Map Visualization builds the technology that turns map data into what people actually see - satellite imagery, buildings, roads, and live map content - across mobile devices and in-car systems. The Visualization Engines team owns the rendering engines behind it: a Unity-based 3D map renderer and an in-house C++ rendering engine, both shipping to phones and to automotive customers.  
  
We are looking for an engineer to strengthen our rendering and computer graphics expertise while staying comfortable contributing to the mobile SDK layer around it.  
  
**What you will do**

* Design technical solutions to complex problems at scale: large map scenes, tight frame budgets, constrained mobile and automotive hardware.

* Work across the rendering stack: from the C# and mobile APIs our SDK consumers use down to the graphics pipeline and shader-level work.

* Take ownership of your area and lead changes within the team.

* Build iteratively using agile methods.

* Work with AI as a standard part of engineering practice - we use it heavily and expect you to.

**What you will need**

* A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, and 3+ years of equivalent experience in at least one modern programming language.

* Strong C++ or C# or Kotlin or Swift - we expect you are genuinely productive in at least one of them.

* Comfortable contributing to the mobile SDK layer

* Knowledge and practice of professional software engineering across the full development lifecycle: coding standards, code reviews, source control, build processes, testing, and operations.

* Comfortable communicating in English, written and spoken.

**One of these two profiles is you**  
  
Beyond the essentials above, we need one of these two backgrounds. We are deliberately flexible about which: we will trade depth in one area for the appetite to grow in the other, so you need one profile, not both.  
  
Profile A (the mobile engineer).  
You are a strong Android and/or iOS engineer, and you want to move toward rendering and computer graphics.  
  
Profile B (the graphics engineer).  
You work in computer graphics, rendering engines, or visualization, and you are interested in learning mobile platform development.  
  
**Nice to have**

* Unity engine and/or APIs: Vulkan, OpenGL, ...

* Shader authoring and graphics pipeline optimization.

* Kotlin and/or Swift - both are in use in our SDK and demo applications.

* Automotive software.

* Working with large geospatial or other large-scale datasets.

**What you get**  
  
You learn AI while doing your actual job: We use AI heavily in day-to-day engineering, and you get access to current frontier models. Working here means building that skill on real production work - paid, in working hours, not as a side project after them.  
  
A stack that is broad and you can move around inside it: Rendering and graphics engineering, mobile development on both Android and iOS, automotive software, cloud-connected visualization systems. The point is not just that all of it exists here but that moving from one to another is normal and easy. Whichever profile you come from, the expectation is that over time you pick up the other side too, alongside colleagues already working in it.  
  
Work that really uses what you know: Rendering maps at scale, finding performance inside a frame budget, processing large volumes of geospatial data, delivering it on mobile and automotive hardware. It is the kind of engineering where your existing knowledge is in play and there is a steady supply of challenging problems worth thinking about.  
  
Work you can point at: What you build becomes visible as beautiful maps used by end users and by our automotive customers.  
  
Interested but not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway - good motivation carries lot of weight here.

**What we offer**

  

A competitive compensation package, of course.

Time and resources to grow and develop, including a personal development budget and paid leave for learning days, as well as paid access to e-learning resources such as O’Reilly and LinkedIn Learning.

Time to support life outside of work, with enhanced parental leave plus paid leave to care for loved ones and volunteer in local communities.

  

Work flexibility, where TomTom’ers, in agreement with their manager and team, use both the office and home to focus, collaborate, learn and socialize. It’s all about getting the best out of both worlds – we ask TomTom’ers to come to the office two days a week, and the remaining three are free to be worked in either location.

Improve your home office with a setup budget and get extra support with a monthly allowance.

Enjoy options to work from your home country and abroad for a set number of days each year, to visit family and friends, or to simply explore the world we’re mapping.

Take the holidays you want with a competitive holiday plan, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday.

Join annual events like our Hackathon and DevDays to bring your ideas to life with talented teammates from around the world.

Become a part of our inclusive global culture and have the chance to collaborate with a diverse community – we have over 80 nationalities at TomTom!

Find out more about our global benefits and enjoy additional local benefits tailored to your location.

**Meet your team**

We are the Map Visualization Product Unit. We develop map rendering technology that can be integrated into navigation systems and location-based applications, providing our technology to our customers in the form of cloud-based APIs and SDKs.

We see quality-management processes as a source of competitive advantage. As part of our product-led and outcome-oriented culture, we believe it is crucial to have mechanisms in place to measure and improve the quality of our products in a continuous manner so we can achieve our mission of mapping the world in real time.

**At TomTom...**

You’ll help people find their way in the world. In 2004, TomTom revolutionized how the world moves with the introduction of the first portable navigation device. Now, we intend to do it again by engineering the first-ever real-time map, the smartest and most useful map on the planet.

Work with a team of 3,300+ unique, curious and passionate problem-solvers. Together, we’ll open up a world of possibilities for car manufacturers, enterprises and developers to help people understand and get closer to the world around them.

**After you apply**

Our recruitment team will work hard to give you a meaningful experience throughout your journey with us, no matter the outcome. Your application will be screened closely and you can rest assured that all follow-up actions will be thorough, from assessments and interviews all the way through onboarding. To find out more about our application process, check out our hiring FAQs.

**TomTom is an equal opportunity employer**

TomTom is where you can find your place in the world. Every day we welcome, nurture and celebrate differences. Why? Because your uniqueness is what makes you, *you*. No matter your culture or background, you’ll find your impact at TomTom. Research also shows that sometimes women and underrepresented communities can be hesitant to apply for positions unless they believe they meet 100% of the criteria. If you can relate to this, please know that we’d love to hear from you.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Software Developer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
**Join Our Team as a Software Developer (m/f/d)**

  

As one of the leading providers of high-end digital printing solutions, Canon Production Printing continuously sets new standards with its best-in-class high-end digital printers for various markets, such as ultra-fast photo book printing. Our customers rely on our printers for their business success, so productivity, quality, and easy usability are key.

Creating a good user experience and robust, smart logic is crucial, as it increases customer satisfaction and productivity. This involves understanding customer requirements, translating them into a sustainable design, and realizing features through to release.

  

**Your challenge as Software Developer (m/f/d):**

  

* Develop software steering the digital print engine, covering everything from an innovative operator interface (web-based) and control functionality like job/color/media management to smart connectivity to integrate into customer environments
* Take charge of conceptualizing, planning, realizing, and documenting innovative solutions
* Be part of an international project team
* Collaborate with interdisciplinary development teams, such as UX design, engine projects, quality assurance and service
  

**Who are we looking for?**

  

* You want to learn to shape and lead; you see the positive side of things
* You have a bachelor's or master’s degree in e.g. computer-science/-engineering
* You are comfortable communicating in English and German
* You are eager to dive into the field of full-stack web and interface development
* You want to continuously improve your skills. C#, Python, Angular, HTML5, Git and Robot will be your technical environment. We support your learning journey.
* You are eager using AI and to incorporate new technologies into your daily work
* You have or you want to gain experience in visualization and usability design
* You enjoy communicating and working together across sites and borders
  

**What we offer**

  

* A challenging, interesting and responsible job in a future-oriented and international workplace, with the social benefits of a large company.
* A working environment in which you can contribute your experience and personality
* An attractive salary, a flexible working time model and other social benefits of a large company, such as a company pension scheme and work-life balance
* 30 days vacation
* Bicycle leasing
* Discounted local transport ticket
* Individual development prospects and further training opportunities
* A team that is looking forward to your reinforcement
  

**Are you interested?**

Please submit your cover letter and resume stating your period of notice as well as your salary expectations via the ‘apply now’-button. Severely disabled people and people with equivalent disabilities will be given preferential consideration if they are suitable.
  
Please get in touch with Korbinian Huber for further information:
  
E-Mail: korbinian.huber@cpp.canon

**What do we stand for?**

We develop and manufacture high-tech printing products and workflow software for the commercial printing market as part of Canon, a global leader in imaging technologies. With around 3,300 employees across three continents and our headquarters in Venlo, the Netherlands, we innovate to create high-quality solutions that add color to the world. Guided by the philosophy of *Kyosei* —living and working together for the common good—our culture is built on openness, collegiality, trust and stability. We empower our people to grow, take initiative, and make an impact.
  
  
With our company values collaboration, innovation and ownership, we strive to bring out the best in each other, expand boundaries and feel empowered to take ownership of our work.
  
  
Further information about Canon Production Printing is available at cpp.canon .

jobs.title: Software Developer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
**Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams als Softwareentwickler (m/w/d)**

  

Als einer der führenden Anbieter setzt Canon Production Printing mit seinen erstklassigen High-End-Digitaldrucksystemen kontinuierlich neue Maßstäbe in unterschiedlichen Märkten, beispielsweise im ultraschnellen Fotobuchdruck. Unsere Kunden verlassen sich für ihren Geschäftserfolg auf unsere Drucksysteme. Deshalb stehen Produktivität, Qualität und eine einfache Bedienbarkeit für uns an erster Stelle.

Eine herausragende Benutzererfahrung sowie eine robuste und intelligente Softwarelogik sind entscheidend, um Kundenzufriedenheit und Produktivität zu steigern. Dazu gehört es, Kundenanforderungen zu verstehen, diese in nachhaltige Konzepte zu übersetzen und innovative Funktionen bis zur Markteinführung umzusetzen.

  

**Ihre Herausforderung als Softwareentwickler (m/w/d)**

  

* Entwicklung von Software zur Steuerung unserer digitalen Drucksysteme. Das Spektrum reicht von einer innovativen webbasierten Benutzeroberfläche über Steuerungsfunktionen wie Job-, Farb- und Medienmanagement bis hin zu intelligenten Schnittstellen zur Integration in die IT-Landschaft unserer Kunden.
* Verantwortung für die Konzeption, Planung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation innovativer Softwarelösungen.
* Mitarbeit in einem internationalen Projektteam.
* Enge Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Entwicklungsteams, beispielsweise aus den Bereichen UX-Design, Druckwerksentwicklung, Qualitätssicherung und Service.
  

**Wen suchen wir?**

  

* Sie möchten lernen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Dinge aktiv mitzugestalten. Dabei behalten Sie stets eine positive Einstellung.
* Sie verfügen über ein abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium, beispielsweise in Informatik, Software Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang.
* Sie kommunizieren sicher in deutscher und englischer Sprache.
* Sie möchten tief in die Bereiche Full-Stack-Webentwicklung und Schnittstellenentwicklung eintauchen.
* Sie haben den Wunsch, Ihre Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Technologien wie C#, Python, Angular, HTML5, Git und Robot Framework bilden dabei Ihr technisches Umfeld. Wir unterstützen Sie aktiv auf Ihrem Lernweg.
* Sie sind offen für den Einsatz von KI-Technologien und möchten neue Technologien in Ihren Arbeitsalltag integrieren.
* Sie haben bereits Erfahrung im Bereich Visualisierung und Usability Design oder möchten diese aufbauen.
* Sie arbeiten gerne mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen über Standorte und Ländergrenzen hinweg zusammen.
  

**Was bieten wir Ihnen?**

  

* Eine anspruchsvolle, interessante und verantwortungsvolle Aufgabe in einem zukunftsorientierten und international agierenden Unternehmen
* Ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Sie Ihre Erfahrung und Persönlichkeit einbringen können
* Eine attraktive Vergütung, ein flexibles Arbeitszeitmodell sowie weitere Sozialleistungen eines Großunternehmens, wie z.B. betriebliche Altersversorgung und Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie
* 30 Tage Urlaub
* Fahrradleasing
* Vergünstigtes Nahverkehrsticket
* Individuelle Entwicklungsperspektiven und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
Ein Team, das sich auf Ihre Verstärkung freut  

**Sind Sie interessiert?**

  

Dann stellen Sie uns bitte Ihre Bewerbungsunterlagen unter Angabe Ihrer Kündigungsfrist sowie Ihrer Gehaltsvorstellung über den "Jetzt bewerben"-Button zur Verfügung.
  
Schwerbehinderte und ihnen gleichgestellte behinderte Menschen werden bei entsprechender Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt. Für weitere Informationen zu dieser Stelle wenden Sie sich bitte an Korbinian Huber:
  
E-Mail: korbinian.huber@cpp.canon

**Wofür stehen wir?**
---------------------

Wir entwickeln und fertigen High-Tech Druckprodukte und Workflow-Software für den kommerziellen Druckmarkt als Teil von Canon, einem weltweit führenden Unternehmen in der Bildverarbeitungstechnologie. Mit rund 3.300 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern auf drei Kontinenten und unserem Hauptsitz in Venlo, Niederlande, innovieren wir, um hochwertige Lösungen zu schaffen, die Farbe in die Welt bringen. Geleitet von der Philosophie des Kyosei – zusammenleben und arbeiten für das Gemeinwohl – basiert unsere Kultur auf Offenheit, Kollegialität, Vertrauen und Stabilität. Wir befähigen unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter, zu wachsen, die Initiative zu ergreifen und etwas zu bewirken.
  
  
Mit unseren Unternehmenswerten Zusammenarbeit, Innovation und Eigenverantwortung streben wir danach, das Beste in jedem und jeder von uns hervorzubringen, Grenzen zu erweitern und uns ermutigt zu fühlen, Verantwortung für unsere Arbeit zu übernehmen.
  
  
Weitere Informationen über Canon Production Printing finden Sie unter cpp.canon.

Gestartet als Spin-off der TU München, haben wir, die MVTec Software GmbH, uns zu einem international führenden Softwareentwickler für industrielle Bildverarbeitung entwickelt. MVTec-Produkte werden in unterschiedlichsten Anwendungsgebieten eingesetzt, unter anderem in der Elektro- und Halbleiterindustrie, der Batterieproduktion, der Landwirtschaft und Nahrungsmittelindustrie sowie der Logistik. Wir arbeiten nach agilen Prinzipien, gehen gemeinsam mit unseren Partnern und Kunden neue Wege, und entwickeln unsere Produkte mit viel Leidenschaft.
  
Wenn du diese Leidenschaft teilst, dann suchen wir dich in Vollzeit als

**Application & Project Engineer Bildverarbeitung (w/m/d)**
-----------------------------------------------------------

**Das erwartet dich:**
----------------------

* Du befähigst unsere Partner und Kunden, unsere Produkte optimal zum Einsatz zu bringen.
* Du erstellst Machbarkeitsstudien mit unseren Produkten und eigenen Programmierumgebungen für kundenspezifische Applikationen, z.B. mit HALCON und HDevelop, MERLIC und dem Deep Learning Tool.

* Gute Kenntnisse in python, C++ oder .NET-Sprachen sowie in Linux- und Windows-Betriebssystemen sind von Vorteil.
* Kommunikationsstärke mit Kunden im internationalen Umfeld sowie eine hohe technische Problemlösefähigkeit zeichnen dich aus.
